stops.note: a repeated-action form of 'wiegen', to rock, itself from 'wiege' (cradle)
stops.meaning: to rock, sway back and forth
to move unsteadily from side to side

stops.note: settled into its modern spelling once used as a noun for the motion itself
stops.meaning: to move with short, quick, irregular movements

current_meaning: to move with small quick side-to-side movements
